river.pick: Which river does {label}, a capital city, stand on?
river.match: Match each capital to the river it stands on.
river.odd: Three of these capitals stand on the {value}. Which one does not?
river.all: Tap all {n} capitals that stand on the {value}.

rows.label: London
rows.description: capital and largest city of England and the United Kingdom
rows.hook: is home to Big Ben, Buckingham Palace and the Tower Bridge

rows.label: Paris
rows.description: capital and most populous city in France
rows.hook: is the City of Light, crowned by an iron tower and home to the Louvre

rows.label: Prague
rows.description: capital city of the Czech Republic
rows.hook: is a city of a hundred spires, with a medieval astronomical clock and a famous stone bridge

rows.label: Amsterdam
rows.description: capital and most populous city of the Netherlands
rows.hook: is a canal-laced city of narrow gabled houses, bicycles and a famous red-light district

rows.label: Jakarta
rows.description: capital and largest city of Indonesia
rows.hook: is a sprawling, traffic-choked megacity on the island of Java

rows.label: Budapest
rows.description: capital and largest city of Hungary
rows.hook: is a city of thermal baths and a grand domed parliament, once two towns joined into one

rows.label: Madrid
rows.description: capital of Spain
rows.hook: is home to the Prado museum and the Royal Palace, and sits near the middle of the Iberian peninsula

rows.label: Bangkok
rows.description: capital of Thailand
rows.hook: is a steamy city of golden temples, tuk-tuks and street food

rows.label: Damascus
rows.description: capital and largest city of Syria
rows.hook: is often called one of the oldest continuously inhabited cities on Earth

rows.label: Warsaw
rows.description: capital and largest city of Poland
rows.hook: is a city rebuilt from wartime ruins, with a reconstructed Old Town and the Palace of Culture

rows.label: Lisbon
rows.description: municipality and capital city of Portugal
rows.hook: is a hilly, tiled-roof city known for yellow trams, custard tarts and a devastating earthquake long ago

rows.label: Bratislava
rows.description: capital city of Slovakia
rows.hook: is a small city with a hilltop castle that sits right beside the borders of two neighbouring countries

rows.label: Cairo
rows.description: capital city of Egypt
rows.hook: is a vast city near the Giza pyramids and the Sphinx

rows.label: New Delhi
rows.description: capital city of India
rows.hook: is a planned seat of government laid out by British architects, with a famous India Gate

rows.label: Sarajevo
rows.description: capital city of Bosnia and Herzegovina
rows.hook: is the city where an assassination helped spark the First World War

rows.label: Kinshasa
rows.description: capital and the largest city of the Democratic Republic of the Congo having the status of a province
rows.hook: is a huge Central African city facing a neighbouring capital just across the water

rows.label: Manila
rows.description: capital city of the Philippines
rows.hook: is a crowded metropolis with jeepneys and a walled Spanish colonial district called Intramuros

rows.label: Ulaanbaatar
rows.description: capital and largest city of Mongolia
rows.hook: is the coldest national capital on Earth, home to nomadic yurt districts

rows.label: Tbilisi
rows.description: capital and the largest city of Georgia (country)
rows.hook: is a hillside city of sulphur baths and balconied old houses at the crossroads of Europe and Asia

rows.label: Baghdad
rows.description: capital city of Iraq
rows.hook: was the centre of the Abbasid caliphate and its House of Wisdom, a medieval hub of learning

rows.label: Kyiv
rows.description: capital and largest city of Ukraine
rows.hook: is a city of golden-domed monasteries and a vast central square known for its protests

rows.label: Dhaka
rows.description: capital and largest city of Bangladesh
rows.hook: is one of the world's most densely crowded cities, famed for its cycle rickshaws

rows.label: Helsinki
rows.description: capital and most populous city of Finland
rows.hook: is a seaside city of saunas, design shops and a white cathedral on a hill

rows.label: Tashkent
rows.description: capital of Uzbekistan
rows.hook: is a Central Asian city on the old Silk Road, rebuilt after a destructive earthquake

rows.label: Yerevan
rows.description: capital and largest city of Armenia
rows.hook: is the rose-coloured city beneath the view of Mount Ararat

rows.label: Bucharest
rows.description: capital and largest city of Romania
rows.hook: was nicknamed Little Paris and holds one of the heaviest buildings on Earth, a huge Parliament palace

rows.label: Astana
rows.description: capital of Kazakhstan
rows.hook: is a futuristic planned city on the steppe that replaced an older capital in the 1990s

rows.label: Hanoi
rows.description: capital of Vietnam
rows.hook: is a city of motorbikes, a lake with a turtle legend, and an old quarter of 36 streets

rows.label: Pyongyang
rows.description: capital city of North Korea
rows.hook: is a secretive city of monuments, wide boulevards and a pyramid-shaped hotel

rows.label: Kabul
rows.description: capital and the largest city of Afghanistan
rows.hook: is a mountain-ringed city with a long history of invading empires and recent wars

rows.label: Santiago
rows.description: capital city of Chile
rows.hook: is a city backed by the snowy Andes, close to wine valleys and the Pacific coast

rows.label: Zagreb
rows.description: capital city of Croatia
rows.hook: is a city of Austro-Hungarian architecture, famous for its Christmas Advent festival and cravat origins

rows.label: Skopje
rows.description: capital city of North Macedonia
rows.hook: is the birthplace of Mother Teresa, filled with statues of heroes of antiquity

rows.label: Nicosia
rows.description: capital of Cyprus
rows.hook: is the last capital in Europe split in two by a dividing buffer zone

rows.label: Bern
rows.description: city in Switzerland, capital of the canton of Bern and de facto capital of Switzerland
rows.hook: is a medieval old town with a clock tower and a pit of live bears, protected by UNESCO

rows.label: Colombo
rows.description: largest city and de facto capital of Sri Lanka
rows.hook: is a bustling port city on the Indian Ocean island once called Ceylon

rows.label: Chișinău
rows.description: capital of Moldova
rows.hook: is a green city surrounded by vineyards, with some of the biggest wine cellars in the world nearby

rows.label: Havana
rows.description: capital and largest city of Cuba
rows.hook: is a city of vintage American cars, crumbling colonial buildings and a seafront Malecón

rows.label: Brussels
rows.description: municipality in the Brussels-Capital Region and capital of Belgium
rows.hook: is a city of waffles, chocolate and a small peeing-boy statue, and the main home of the European Union

rows.label: Caracas
rows.description: capital and largest city of Venezuela
rows.hook: is a South American city in a valley under the Ávila mountain, home to a huge oil-rich nation

rows.label: Luxembourg
rows.description: capital and largest city of Luxembourg
rows.hook: is a tiny grand-ducal city of deep gorges and fortress ruins, and a major banking centre

rows.label: Antananarivo
rows.description: capital and largest city of Madagascar
rows.hook: is a hilltop city on an island famed for lemurs and vanilla

rows.label: Monrovia
rows.description: capital city of Liberia
rows.hook: is a West African port named after a US president, founded for freed American slaves

rows.label: Vientiane
rows.description: capital of Laos
rows.hook: is a laid-back city of French colonial buildings and golden Buddhist temples in Southeast Asia

rows.label: Georgetown
rows.description: capital city of Guyana
rows.hook: is a wooden-house city on the Atlantic coast of South America, built below sea level

rows.label: Tegucigalpa
rows.description: capital and largest city of Honduras
rows.hook: is a Central American highland city with a name from an indigenous word meaning silver hill

rows.label: Asunción
rows.description: capital of Paraguay
rows.hook: is an inland South American city near a border with a much larger neighbour, known as the Mother of Cities

rows.label: Brazzaville
rows.description: capital of the Republic of the Congo
rows.hook: is a central African city that faces another national capital across a wide water boundary

rows.label: Thimphu
rows.description: capital of Bhutan
rows.hook: is a Himalayan city with no traffic lights, in a land that measures Gross National Happiness

rows.label: Vaduz
rows.description: capital of Liechtenstein
rows.hook: is a tiny Alpine town with a castle on a hill, in one of Europe's smallest states

rows.label: Niamey
rows.description: capital of Niger
rows.hook: is a West African city on the edge of the Sahel, in a desert-covered country

rows.label: Freetown
rows.description: capital of Sierra Leone
rows.hook: is a West African port whose name recalls the settlement of freed slaves

rows.label: Bamako
rows.description: capital of Mali

rows.label: Paramaribo
rows.description: capital city of Suriname
rows.hook: is a wooden-building city on the northeast coast of South America with a Dutch-colonial UNESCO-listed core

rows.label: Juba
rows.description: capital of the Republic of South Sudan
rows.hook: is the capital of the world's youngest country, which became independent after a long civil war

rows.label: Bangui
rows.description: capital city of the Central African Republic
rows.hook: is a central African city on the border with its southern neighbour, shaken by repeated conflict

rows.label: Bandar Seri Begawan
rows.description: capital and largest city of Brunei
rows.hook: is a wealthy oil-rich sultanate's city of a huge gold-domed mosque and a village of stilt houses

rows.label: N'Djamena
rows.description: capital and largest city of Chad
rows.hook: is a city on the edge of the Sahara, close to the shores of a shrinking Lake in the Sahel

rows.label: Andorra la Vella
rows.description: capital of Andorra
rows.hook: is a mountain city with duty-free shopping, in a tiny state between France and Spain
